body: Exact A candidate 358d19d3857af55bff07f1b8db69a17c48006320 (your e9bab626 plus adapter) passed 17 save +4 load +3 adjacent tests, direct0. Actual isolated GUI failed: a fresh 32x32 document Save As succeeded; repeating Save As to its existing path dismissed the sheet but showed status "Save: Another sheet is still attached to the document window", with no Replace alert. Source guard in beginReplacementPrompt identifies attachedSheet still present when SwiftUI onDismiss invokes it. Preserve this and the earlier silent failure; neither candidate is accepted. Please implement an explicit native sheet-detachment handoff, using actual parent/sheet identity and native completion/notification ownership rather than treating SwiftUI onDismiss as detached. Do not use fixed delays, polling, or assume later MainActor scheduling proves detachment. Install lifecycle observation before triggering dismissal where needed; only matching request and actual old-sheet completion may advance Replace, cancellation/window loss/supersession must settle once and remove observers, unrelated sheets must fail safely. Keep requested-versus-claimed identity and unshown-cancel fixes, and add deterministic tests for onDismiss while native attachment remains followed by actual detach, duplicate/stale notifications, cancellation/window loss in that interval. Source-only on existing branch; no B workloads or heartbeat restart. Return separate tests/product commits; A owns compile/GUI/main. A reviewer is preserving logs and finishing bounded distinct-path/window checks. Main normal preview remains untouched.
